TARGET_IUS_SEE_MORE_ARIA: View full list of target indicator unit subgroups
PROCESS_APPLIES_TO_ALL_AREAS: This process applies to all areas.
PROCESSES_NO_MATCH: No processes match the current filters.
FILTER_JSON_INVALID: Filter object must be valid JSON.
TIME_PERIODS_NO_MATCH: No time periods match your search.

COMPUTE_TAB_CONFIGURED: Compute rule saved for this subgroup
COMPUTE_TOTAL_ENABLE: Total — Enable compute to calculate sum of subgroups
COMPUTE_NO_IUS_UNDER_IC: No selectable IUS here. Try another branch, the sector filter, or a different unit row.
SELECT_ALL_INDICATORS_CLASSIFICATION: Select all indicators under this classification
NO_INDICATORS_CLASSIFICATION: No indicators available under this classification.
COMPUTE_MINUS_ENABLE: Minus — Enable compute to calculate the difference
COMPUTE_PCT_ENABLE: Percentage — Enable Compute to calculate Percentage using Numerator and Denominator
COMPUTE_PCT_EXAMPLE: Example: % Male = Male / Total Population Size
COMPUTE_MULTIPLIER_HINT: Use 100 to calculate Percentage. Use a multiplier value in other cases. Keep blank for Ratios.
COMPUTE_LATEST_DATA_CHECK: Use latest data if same time period data not available
COMPUTE_TP_ENABLE: Time period — Enable compute for totaling time periods
COMPUTE_TP_EXAMPLE: Example: Annual = Q1 + Q2 + Q3 + Q4
COMPUTE_AREA_ENABLE: Area — Enable compute to roll up values from finer areas into parent areas
COMPUTE_AREA_EXAMPLE: Example: aggregate child-area data into each parent area at the target level (same indicator, unit, and subgroup).
COMPUTE_AREA_LEVEL_HINT: Target level must be a smaller area_level number than the source level (coarser parent vs finer children), matching your warehouse hierarchy.
COMPUTE_AREA_POPULATE_MID: Populate intermediate levels (cascade step by step toward the target)
COMPUTE_AREA_SAVE_FAILED: Could not save the Area compute rule. Choose valid target and source levels (target level must be less than source level), or turn off Area.
COMPUTE_AREA_LEVELS_REQUIRED: Choose both target and source area levels.
COMPUTE_AREA_LEVELS_ORDER: Target area level must be less than source area level (coarser parent vs finer children).
COMPUTE_PROCESS_AREA_FILTER_IGNORED: For Area processes, area filters here are not used — jobs run for every area at each formula’s target level.
COMPUTE_APPLY_ALL_SUBGROUPS: Apply to all subgroups ("{subgroup}") of all indicators with the same unit ("{unit}")?
COMPUTE_APPLY_OTHER_SUBGROUPS: Apply to other subgroups of this indicator with the same unit ("{unit}")?
COMPUTE_NO_SUBGROUPS: Add subgroups on the Subgroups tab to configure compute rules.
COMPUTE_TOTAL_SAVE_FAILED: Could not save the Total compute rule. Add at least one source IUS or turn off Total.
COMPUTE_TOTAL_BLOCKED: This row already has a different compute type. Remove it in the API or pick another IUS before using Total.
COMPUTE_TOTAL_SOURCES_CACHE_HINT: A Total rule exists on the server, but this app cannot load which rows are summed until the API returns that list. This browser shows the last saved selection from here only—it may be incomplete on a new device or after edits elsewhere.
COMPUTE_CALCULATE_IUS_PAGE_HINT: Manage compute process definitions. Use + to add a row (same as legacy Data → Calculate IUS).
COMPUTE_CALCULATE_IUS_INFO_BODY: Use the tabs to switch execution type (total, minus, percentage, time period, area). Column filters use searchable lists from this warehouse. Expand “Add compute process” to pick target IUS, source publisher, and title, then save. For Area, spatial scope comes from each IUS’s saved Area formula, not the area columns on the add row. Double-click publisher or title on a row to edit inline.
COMPUTE_ADD_ROW_EXPAND_FIRST: Expand the add row to create a process
COMPUTE_EXECUTE_BLURB: Run a saved compute process for the selected time periods. Create or remove definitions on the Calculate IUS tab.
INDICATOR_PLEASE_SELECT_SECTOR: Please select a sector from the dropdown above
INDICATOR_PLEASE_SELECT_THEME: Please select a theme from the dropdown above
INDICATOR_PLEASE_SELECT_GOAL: Please select a goal from the dropdown above
INDICATOR_PLEASE_SELECT_CLASSIFICATION: Please select a {type} from the dropdown above
COMPUTE_NO_ELIGIBLE_TARGET_IUS: No IUS have a saved formula for this operation yet. Configure formulas on the indicator first, then add processes here.
COMPUTE_PROCESS_MANAGE_BLURB: Create a compute process definition (operation type and filter JSON), then run it from the Run tab. Filters often include areas and ius_selection; align values with your warehouse and saved formulas.
COMPUTE_PROCESS_MODAL_SCOPE_HINT: Default scope is used automatically (same idea as the legacy Calculate IUS app—you usually only pick the operation type). Open advanced only if you need custom area or IUS filters.
COMPUTE_PROCESS_ADVANCED_FILTERS_HELP: For integrators: JSON sent as filter_object to the API (e.g. areas, ius_selection). Leave empty to use {}.
COMPUTE_PROCESS_DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete this process definition? This cannot be undone.
COMPUTE_PROCESS_DEFAULT_FILTER_HINT: Default is empty object {}. Add areas and ius_selection when your jobs require them.
COMPUTE_EXECUTE_NO_PROCESSES: No process definitions yet. Open the Calculate IUS tab and click + to add one.
COMPUTE_EXECUTE_STARTED: Compute execution started. Jobs are running in the background.
COMPUTE_EXECUTE_PICK_TP: Select at least one time period, or turn on “All time periods”.
COMPUTE_EXEC_LOG_DELETE_LEAD: Remove “{name}” from your execution history? This cannot be undone from the UI.
COMPUTE_INDICATOR_UNIT_REQUIRED: Set the indicator and unit on this row before configuring compute.
COMPUTE_MINUS_BLOCKED: This row already has a different compute type. Remove it in the API or pick another IUS before using Minus.
COMPUTE_MINUS_SAVE_FAILED: Could not save the Minus compute rule. Choose both Minuend and Subtrahend IUS, or turn off Minus.
ERRORS_API_URL_HINT: Ensure the API is running and NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL is correct.
CHANGELOG_DESCRIPTION: All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.
LOGIN_DESCRIPTION: Create and manage indicators, classifications, areas, and dimensions. Standardize measurement units and metadata so teams can enter data faster and report with confidence.
DATA_ENTRY_INFO_BODY: Choose a workflow and dataset, set filters, then enter or review indicator values. Submit for review when your entries are complete. Additional APIs for datasets and grid rows will connect here as they become available.
APP_CONFIG_UNIT_FORMAT_INTRO: Tick the formats for which the API applies unit formatting on data values. Unticked formats still appear in unit settings but values are returned as plain decimals without special formatting.
APP_CONFIG_UNIT_FORMAT_EMPTY_CATALOG: Unit format catalog is not configured. Run the toolkit seed for UNIT_DATA_FORMAT_CATALOG.
APP_CONFIG_NO_KEYS_IN_TAB: No configuration keys are available for this tab.
APP_CONFIG_IC_TYPES_INTRO: Tick the types that should appear in the app and in adaptation. When all are ticked, the saved value is an empty list (no restriction — same as legacy “all enabled”).
APP_CONFIG_IC_TYPES_AT_LEAST_ONE: Keep at least one type selected. Clearing every type would fall back to “all types enabled” in the API — use all ticked for that instead.
PRODUCTS_INTRO: Manage the registered application products. Update the app name, origin URL, description, and toggle the status for each product.
PRODUCTS_ORIGIN_URL_INVALID: Must be a valid http:// or https:// URL.
SSO_PROVIDERS_CLIENT_SECRET_PLACEHOLDER: Not set — enter a value to add one
SSO_PROVIDERS_SAVE_PARTIAL: Some providers could not be saved
APP_CFG_FIELD_APP_NAME_HELP: Primary name shown for this application on the login screen.
APP_CFG_FIELD_APP_TITLE_HELP: Title shown in the browser tab and inside the application.
APP_CFG_FIELD_APP_ID_HELP: Internal identifier for this app client (read-only when system-managed).
APP_CFG_FIELD_LANGUAGE_DEFAULT_HELP: Default locale code when none is selected.
APP_CFG_FIELD_ENABLED_IC_TYPES_HELP: Which IC types are exposed to the Data Manager and adaptation clients (e.g. list filters, IC APIs). Empty JSON array [] means all types are enabled. Ticking types updates indicator-classifications visibility JSON so both match when you save.
APP_CFG_FIELD_UNIT_DATA_FORMAT_CATALOG_H: Controls which unit format codes apply formatting when data values are returned. Disabled codes fall back to plain decimal display.
APP_CFG_FIELD_APP_FOOTER_NOTE_HELP: Footer line shown at the bottom of the app.
APP_CFG_FIELD_IUS_GID_SEPARATOR_HELP: Platform-wide single character joining composite IUS global ids across all DFA products.
APP_CFG_FIELD_ALLOWED_IMPORT_FILE_SIZE_M: Maximum upload size in megabytes (MiB) for XLSX and CSV imports across the app.
Applies to translations, workflow datapoints, areas, and other import endpoints.
APP_CFG_FIELD_SSO_ENABLED_HELP: Platform-wide toggle applied to all DFA products. When true, login is SSO-only; when false, local username/password login is used.
APP_CFG_FIELD_FLAVOR_COLOR_INPUT_HINT: The swatch sets a #hex value. You can still type any valid CSS color (rgb(), named colors, etc.).
APP_CFG_FIELD_FLAVOR_COLOR_HOVER_INPUT_H: The swatch sets a #hex value. You can still type any valid CSS color (rgb(), named colors, etc.).
APP_CFG_FIELD_FLAVOR_FAVICON_HELP: Favicon image for the app (stored in configuration as a data URL when you choose a file).
APP_CFG_FIELD_FLAVOR_FAVICON_INPUT_HINT: Recommended: .ico or .png, about 500 KB or less. Large files may fail to save.
APP_CFG_FIELD_FLAVOR_LOGO_HELP: Logo image for the app (stored in configuration as a data URL when you choose a file).
APP_CFG_FIELD_FLAVOR_LOGO_INPUT_HINT: Recommended: .png or .jpg, about 1 MB or less. Large files may fail to save.
APP_CONFIG_IMAGE_FILE_TOO_LARGE: That file is larger than the recommended limit for this field. Use a smaller image.

OPTIMIZE_DESCRIPTION: Click on the 'Optimize' button to convert all the tables and its columns to lowercase, ensure primary keys, rebuild indexes, and perform other essential database maintenance operations.
DEFAULT_SUBGROUP_DESCRIPTION: For each (indicator, unit) pair: if no row is marked default, set exactly one as default (prefers subgroup matching DEFAULT_SYSTEM_DW_SUBGROUP_GID).

SET_IUS_DATA_EXIST_DESCRIPTION: Set ut_indicator_unit_subgroup.data_exist from actual ut_data rows (1 if at least one data row exists for that IUS, else 0).
ENSURE_PRIMARY_KEYS: Add PRIMARY KEY on AUTO_INCREMENT columns
REBUILD_INDEXES: Apply DI7 index set from INDEXES_DI7_MYSQL.txt

SEED_SYSTEM_INITIAL_DEFAULTS: Insert defaults into db_version, ut_language, etc.
VALIDATE_SYNC_NEW_COLUMNS: Add is_system column to subgroup tables

ENFORCE_FK_REFERENTIAL_INTEGRITY: Convert tables to InnoDB, add FK constraints

PASSWORD_SAME_AS_OLD: New password must be different from the old password
ROLE_PERM_FORM_SUBTITLE: Resource group rows only organize the tree. Grant access with the checkboxes on leaf resources (right). HTTP verbs match server CRUD_HTTP_METHOD_MAP.
ROLE_PERM_LOAD_RESOURCES_FAILED: Could not load the resource list.
ROLE_PERM_CANNOT_SAVE_NO_GET: Existing permissions could not be loaded from the server, so saving is disabled to avoid wiping this role's assignments. The API needs GET /iam/roles/{role_id}/resource-permissions returning resources with permission letters (C, R, U, D), matching the PUT payload shape.
ROLE_PERM_SUPER_ADMIN_INFERRED: Super-admin role: assignable permissions are shown per resource (from registered APIs). At runtime this role still receives full access via the super-admin flag.
ROLE_PERM_CRUD_NOT_AVAILABLE: No API route uses this method on this resource — assign on the child resource instead (e.g. iam_role, not iam).
ROLE_PERM_APPLICABLE_HINT: Only enabled checkboxes can be saved (registered API methods). Resource groups do not carry permissions—assign on the leaf resources under each group.

LANGUAGES_INFO_BODY: This page lists the languages configured for the selected data warehouse. Use Import to upload language data from an Excel file, Export to download the current list, and Delete to remove selected languages. Each language can be set as the default or globally locked from the list.
SOURCES_INFO_BODY: This page lists all data sources registered in the selected data warehouse. Use Export to download the current list as an Excel file, and Delete to remove selected sources. You can edit source names inline by double-clicking a row.
TOOLS_INFO_BODY: This page provides maintenance and optimization tools for the selected data warehouse. Use Optimize to normalize tables, rebuild indexes, and enforce referential integrity. The other tabs allow you to mark default subgroups, set ISMRD flags, and update IUS data-exist markers.
MOBILE_APP_INFO_BODY: This page lets you configure and publish data packages for the mobile application. Select database content, indicator classifications, time periods, and languages to include, then create a package. Use the History tab to view previously published packages.
SUBGROUP_UPDATE_CONFIRM_IUS_MESSAGE: If you update the subgroup, all the associated IUS will be updated. Are you sure you want to update the subgroup?
SUBGROUP_REMOVAL_CONFIRM_LEAD: You are removing {count} subgroup association(s) from this indicator. This action will disassociate the following subgroups.
IUS_NO_IC_MAPPING: IUS Not Mapped to Any IC
SUBGROUPS_VALS_NOT_IN_IUS: SubgroupVals Not Used in Any IUS
DATA_MISSING_MRD: IUS+Area Combos With No MRD Row
DATA_ORPHAN_IUS: Data Rows With Missing IUS Reference
DATA_ORPHAN_AREA: Data Rows With Missing Area Reference
DATA_ORPHAN_TIMEPERIOD: Data Rows With Missing Time Period Reference
DATA_ORPHAN_SOURCE: Data Rows With Missing Source Reference
BUILDING_PACKAGE_BANNER: Package v{v} is being built — this may take a few moments.
SOURCE_DATA_OPTION: Source Data - changes made in the Source module
AREA_DATA_OPTION: Area Data - changes made in the Areas or Area Level modules
INDICATOR_DATA_OPTION: Indicator Data - for any Indicator related details e.g. in Indicators, indicators classifications, units etc
IC_DATA_OPTION: Indicator Classification Data - for indicator classification related details e.g. Goals, Sectors, Themes etc
DATA_FOLDERS_OPTION: Data Folders - changes in data values for any IUS combination
SELECT_IC_TYPE_DESCRIPTION: Select at least one of the Indicator Classification types to classify the indicators in the mobile application
SELECT_TIME_PERIODS_EXCLUDE_DESCRIPTION: Select Time Periods which you want to exclude in the mobile application
LANGUAGES_SELECTION_DESCRIPTION: The Language option should be selected depending on which language data needs to be updated in the mobile app
COMMENTS_DESCRIPTION: You may add in any description and comments regarding the changes being published.
ERROR_SELECT_CONTENT: At least one database content type must be selected.
ERROR_SELECT_IC_TYPE: At least one indicator classification type must be selected.
ERROR_SELECT_LANGUAGE: At least one language must be selected.
IS_DEFAULT_SUBGROUP_DESC: true = default-subgroup IUS only; false = non-default IUS only; all = all subgroups (no auto-filter). Ignored when subgroup or IUS is set.
AGG_FUNCTIONS_DISABLED_HINT: Select at least one aggregate dimension to enable functions
REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: Request is too large — too many items selected. Please reduce your selection and try again.
DATA_VALUE_BELOW_MIN_ADJUSTED: Value is below the minimum allowed ({min}). It has been adjusted to {min}.
SUBGROUPS_BULK_DELETE_NO_IDS: No valid subgroup IDs found for deletion
SUBGROUPS_DIMENSION_VALUES_IDS_UNIQUE: Dimension values and IDs should be unique inside a dimension.
SUBGROUPS_PANEL_VALUE_ID_REQUIRED: Each saved subgroup value must have a non-empty Id before saving.
